Camera Profiles.title: Camera Profiles
Camera Profiles.description: Set distance and framing for standard, locked-on, and mounted camera modes.

Zoom Modifier.title: Zoom Modifier
Zoom Modifier.description: Hold the binding and move the right thumbstick up or down to adjust the active camera profile distance.

Camera Rotation.title: Camera Rotation
Camera Rotation.description: Adjust how the right thumbstick, arrow keys, and mouse-edge panning move the camera.

Mouse and Keyboard.title: Mouse and Keyboard
Mouse and Keyboard.description: Capture arrow keys and mouse movement at the edge of the game window.

Appearance.title: Appearance
Appearance.description: Click Apply to save typeface, size, shared control width, and border width.

Colors.title: Colors
Colors.description: Customize the panel background, text, and interaction colors.

panelFont.label: Font Family
panelFont.description: Select the typeface used by this config window.

panelControlWidth.label: Control Width
panelControlWidth.description: Set the shared width for sliders, toggles, and dropdowns.

panelBorderWidth.label: Border Width
panelBorderWidth.description: Set the panel and section border thickness.

Enable Mouse and Keyboard.label: Enable Mouse and Keyboard
Enable Mouse and Keyboard.description: Use keyboard arrow keys and position the cursor at a game-window edge to rotate the camera.

Mouse Sensitivity.label: Mouse Sensitivity
Mouse Sensitivity.description: Adjust rotation speed while the cursor is at a game-window edge.

Keyboard Sensitivity.label: Keyboard Sensitivity
Keyboard Sensitivity.description: Adjust rotation speed while holding a camera arrow key.

Zoom Modifier.label: Zoom Modifier
Zoom Modifier.description: Hold this binding and move the right stick vertically to zoom.

Zoom Speed.label: Zoom Speed
Zoom Speed.description: Set how quickly the active profile zooms.

Distance.label: Distance
Distance.description: Camera distance from its current anchor.

Font Family.label: Font Family
Font Family.description: Select the typeface used by this config window.

Control Width.label: Control Width
Control Width.description: Set the shared width for sliders, toggles, and dropdowns.

Border Width.label: Border Width
Border Width.description: Set the panel and section border thickness.

Locked-On.label: Locked-On
Locked-On.description: Camera profile used while locked on to a target.
